properties.address: Jerseyville Avenue at the Freehold Borough border
properties.existing_conditions: Former Nestle coffee plant, closed November 2023; plant building to be demolished
properties.plan_doc: Freehold Twp Amended Round 4 HEFSP (Thomas Planning; adopted 6/19/25, amended 1/19/26; PB hearing 3/5/26, TC endorsed R-26-64 3/10/26)
properties.notes: 45.3-acre property split with Freehold Borough (26.8 ac in the Borough); only the 18.5 Township acres counted. Lot 34 stays open space.

zone.zone_name: Nestle Redevelopment Zone (Nestle Plant Site Redevelopment Plan)
zone.applies_to: Block 43, Lots 28, 29, 30, 31, 32, 33 and 34 (Township portion of the Nestle plant, about 18.5 acres)
zone.permitted_uses: Multi-family (non-age-restricted) family rental residential; accessory recreation/common elements, parking, EV charging, signs, bike storage, stormwater facilities, passive recreation, paths, fences up to 6 ft, refuse enclosures
zone.min_lot_area: 15 acres (applies to the redevelopment area as a whole)
zone.setbacks: Principal building: front 100 ft, rear 100 ft, side 75 ft; 100 ft between residential and non-residential uses; parking 25 ft from all property lines
zone.parking: Per NJ RSIS and Sec. 190-162; EV charging per state law
zone.other_standards: Amendment (Ord. O-26-10) raised density from 18 to 20 UPA and set-aside from 20% to 22% (78 affordable). FAR 0.5. Density/FAR on minimum developable area (excludes floodplain, wetlands and buffers, steep slopes, high water table). 50 ft scenic corridor buffer along the railroad; 25 ft landscaped buffer on Jerseyville Ave; 25-30% of tract as common open space; clubhouse at least 1,200 sf (15 sf per unit) operating by 50% of COs; Lot 34 kept as open space; Township part of the Nestle building to be demolished. Planning Board may not waive height by more than 10 ft or 10%.
zone.ordinance_status: Adopted Ord. O-25-24 (11/10/2025); amended by Ord. O-26-10 (introduced 2/10/2026)
zone.plan_doc: Freehold Twp Amended Round 4 HEFSP (Thomas Planning; adopted 6/19/25, amended 1/19/26; PB hearing 3/5/26, TC endorsed R-26-64 3/10/26)

zone.zone_name: Inclusionary Development District B (Church Street Warehouse Site)
zone.applies_to: Block 34, Lot 8 (Church Street)
zone.permitted_uses: Apartment and townhouse dwellings (district intended for age-restricted rental housing); accessory clubhouse, pools, recreation, parking/garages, EV charging, solar, stormwater, sheds, signs, fences
zone.min_lot_area: Tract 3.0 ac; subdivided lots: townhouse 2,000 sf/unit, multi-family 30,000 sf
zone.min_frontage: Lot width: townhouse 20 ft/unit, multi-family 100 ft; lot depth 100 ft / 200 ft
zone.max_height: Townhouse 3.5 stories / 40 ft; multi-family 3 stories / 40 ft; clubhouse 2 stories / 35 ft; accessory 15 ft
zone.max_impervious_coverage: Lot coverage: townhouse 75%, multi-family 40%; single-parcel condominium development 40% impervious
zone.setbacks: Subdivided lots: front 25 ft (TH) / 50 ft (MF); side 20 ft between buildings (TH) / 30 ft (MF); rear 25 ft (TH) / 30 ft (MF). Accessory: side 3/10 ft, rear 5/10 ft. Single-parcel separations: front-front 60, front-side 40, front-rear 60, side-side 50, side-rear 40, rear-rear 40 ft. 25 ft landscape buffer around the tract
zone.parking: Per NJ Residential Site Improvement Standards
zone.other_standards: Recreation at least 50 sf per unit; no accessory structures in front yard; patios/decks/balconies may encroach but not within 20 ft of a property line; porches may encroach 10 ft into front yard; stormwater facilities maintained by an HOA; affordable units per Code 25-6.7
zone.ordinance_status: Ord. 4-2026 (introduced 2/19/2026; establishes Code 25-4.20 and rezones Block 34 Lot 8)
zone.plan_doc: Aberdeen Ord. 4-2026, Inclusionary Development District B (copy supplied by Nick, 11/23/2026)

properties.plan_doc: Eatontown Amended HEFSP (Leon S. Avakian, February 2026; PB adoption resolution and Council Res. 74-2026 e-filed 3/17/26)
properties.notes: 32 multi-family affordable units and 126 townhouses; about 8,000 sf retail kept; 32 credits + 16 redevelopment bonus. Settlement Memorandum of Agreement 1/29/26.

zone.applies_to: Block 603, Lots 1 and 2 (Hope Road / Pine Brook Road); underlying B-4 Business Zone
zone.permitted_uses: Townhomes (traditional and stacked), multifamily units, senior housing/active adult, retail/commercial, mixed residential and retail; accessory parking, clubhouse and amenities, signs, EV charging, stormwater facilities
zone.max_height: Townhouse 45 ft / 3 stories; multifamily 50 ft / 3 stories; non-residential 30 ft / 2 stories; mixed use 50 ft / 3 stories
zone.setbacks: Tract perimeter 50 ft along Hope Road and Pine Brook Road, 25 ft other lot lines; townhouse building spacing front-front 50 ft, front-side 50 ft, side-side 25 ft, side-rear 50 ft; 10 ft to parking
zone.parking: Residential RSIS; non-residential 1 per 250 sf; loading 1 per 20,000 sf
zone.other_standards: Max units per building: townhouse 16, multifamily 32, mixed use 32. Townhouse lots: min width 20 ft, depth 60 ft. Exempt from tree removal (Ch. 89-3.C, Ch. 307) and landscape/buffer (89-39) rules. Plan text says 158 units (32 affordable multi-family, 126 townhouses).
zone.ordinance_status: Draft ordinance in Appendix B (introduction date blank, 2026)
zone.plan_doc: Eatontown Amended HEFSP (Leon S. Avakian, February 2026; PB adoption resolution and Council Res. 74-2026 e-filed 3/17/26)
